gloss: to push aside; to shove out of the way

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {押|お}しのけていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to push aside; to shove out of the way
definitions.explanation: To physically move someone or something out of one's path by pushing. A compound of 押す (to push) + のける (to move aside).
To disregard or overcome opposition, objections, or rivals in order to proceed. Used figuratively for pushing past obstacles.

examples.english: I pushed people aside and moved to the front.

examples.japanese: ⟦{邪魔|じゃま}→邪魔：01610_jama⟧な⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}しのけて⟦{通路|つうろ}→通路：04062_tsuuro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I pushed the obstructing luggage aside to clear the aisle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{満員|まんいん}→満員：07584_manin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}しのける⟦の→の：09472_no⟧はやめてほしい。
examples.english: I wish people would stop shoving others aside on packed trains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{反対|はんたい}{意見|いけん}→反対意見：24246_hantaiiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}しのけて⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めた→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: They pushed aside the opposing views and proceeded with the plan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{強豪|きょうごう}⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}しのけて⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}した→優勝する：25496_yuushousuru⟧。
examples.english: She beat out the powerhouse teams and won the championship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}しのけて⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{達成|たっせい}する→達成する：22183_tasseisuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{意志|いし}→意志：01712_ishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: To overcome difficulties and achieve your goal, you need a strong will.

notes:
USAGE:
{押|お}しのける is an ichidan verb. It can take a direct object marked with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}しのける (push a person aside).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}しのける (push people aside)
- ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}しのける (push one's way through)
- ⟦ライバル→ライバル：11197_raibaru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}しのける (beat out rivals)
- ⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}しのける (override opposition)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{押|お}しのける implies forceful removal from one's path. {押|お}し{退|の}ける is an alternate kanji spelling with the same meaning. ⟦{突|つ}き{飛|と}ばす→突き飛ばす：06135_tsukitobasu⟧ means "to shove away" with more violent force.
